messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Pediatric Dose for Generalized Anxiety Disorder:
7 to 17 years: -Initial dose: 30 mg orally once a day for at least 2 weeks -Maintenance dose: 30 to 60 mg orally once a day -Maximum dose: 120 mg/day.
Usual Pediatric Dose for Fibromyalgia:
13 years and older: -Initial dose: 30 mg orally once a day for at least 1 week -Maintenance dose: 30 to 60 mg orally once a day.
Triplet: ["Duloxetine", "has recommended dose for", "Fibromyalgia in 13 years and older"]

The relation 'has recommended dose for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a recommended dose specified by the object entity for the specific condition and age group.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
